meta.name: Rajneesh Kumar Singh
meta.tagline: Architecting NestJS and GenAI-powered backends for teams across the US, UK and Canada.
meta.resumeStack: NestJS · Node.js · React · GraphQL · GenAI/LLM · AWS

summary: Results-driven Technical Lead and full-stack developer with 10+ years of IT experience, including 8+ years as a backend developer specializing in Node.js. I architect and deliver enterprise web applications for global clients across the US, UK and Canada, leading technical teams of 10+ engineers on scalable backends built with NestJS, Node.js, Express and GraphQL. Recent work centers on shipping production-grade GenAI features using LLM integrations and the Model Context Protocol, backed by hands-on AWS server administration and a broad third-party API and payment-gateway integration background.

experience.title: Technical Lead / Solution Architect
points: Architecting enterprise solutions for US/UK clients using NestJS, Node.js, React and GraphQL across multiple concurrent engagements.
Integrating GenAI capabilities — LLM APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based tool orchestration — to modernize legacy systems and accelerate delivery.
Owning AWS server administration and infrastructure (EC2, S3, SES, SNS, Elastic IP, Auto Scaling) supporting production workloads for global clients.
Mentoring developers, conducting code reviews, and setting architecture and engineering standards across project teams.
Partnering directly with overseas stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical roadmaps.
